scoring_justification: The only scored artifact is nucleation_results.json, an aggregation of the full computation. The checker verifies the reported values satisfy paper-derived thresholds and ranges, which constitutes a structural check on the output consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported thresholds for barrier and NB estimate, and nominal axial ratio.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures (Fig. 9, Discussion, Fig. 5).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper: barrier >50 k_B T (p. "The barrier height ... is greater than 50 k_B T"), NB ≈10 ("roughly 10"), axial ratio ≈20 ("t ≈ 20" from Fig. 5).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the stated results in the paper; the gold values are the paper's own numbers.

outputs.description: Contains the computed free-energy barrier for heterogeneous nucleation at 250 K (should exceed 50 k_B T), the estimated number of dislocations required for realistic interfacial energy (should be ≈10), and the critical axial ratio of the embryo. The checker verifies barrier > 50 k_B T, NB within 20% of 10, and critical axial ratio in [15, 25].

output_contract.notes: The only scored artifact is nucleation_results.json. The checker compares the barrier and NB estimate to the paper's reported thresholds and tolerance. The critical axial ratio is used as a consistency check. No hidden holdout dataset is needed; the gold values are paper-reported thresholds.
